title: A Theory of Play and Fantasy (in Steps to an Ecology of Mind)

publication.publisher_or_container: Ballantine Books (collected essays); originally Psychiatric Research Reports 2:39-51 (1955)
publication.edition: Steps to an Ecology of Mind, pp. 177-193; orig. essay 1955

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed the original 1955 publication (Psychiatric Research Reports 2:39-51), its reprint in Steps to an Ecology of Mind (1972, pp. 177-193), and the 'this is play' metacommunication thesis via secondary scholarship (Mitchell 1991) and an excerpt. Related essay 'The Message This is Play' (1956) noted.
